scope: Palestine medical discovery — An-Najah National University Doctor of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: An-Najah lists its Doctor of Medicine as a six-year, 72-month undergraduate programme awarding a Bachelor degree.

The Faculty describes a 266-credit curriculum in two phases: biomedical sciences followed by clinical medical sciences. Its published clinical-training material identifies An-Najah University Hospital plus government, private and UNRWA facilities, but does not establish their current operating or placement availability.

An-Najah announced in April 2024 that its Doctor of Medicine programme received international accreditation through TEPDAD, whose recognition is through WFME; the page reviewed does not state the accreditation term.

holdReasons: No current fee or mandatory-charge schedule and no live admissions calendar or international-applicant route were located.
Teaching language, current entry requirements, accommodation, scholarships/loans and detailed student-support arrangements were not verified from current authoritative sources.
The published clinical-facility list must not be presented as a current placement guarantee without direct, current confirmation of access, capacity and continuity.
The TEPDAD accreditation validity period and scope need direct accreditor confirmation before publication as a formal recognition statement.
nextAction: Obtain a current admissions and fees notice, direct confirmation of clinical placement continuity and a current TEPDAD record before considering a payload.
